summary: Iteration 8: verified switch to the user's own Clerk dev instance (gentle-kite-1463). /api/clerk/config returns enabled=true, a pk_test key that decodes to gentle-kite-1463.clerk.accounts.dev$, and proxy_url ''. smoke_v3.py passes 11/11. New pytest test_iteration8_own_clerk.py passes 21/21: both Clerk users exist; protected endpoints return 401 without a token or with a bad token; admin gets role=admin and 200 on every /admin/* and /users endpoint; the member gets 403 on admin endpoints and 200 on orders/favorites/cart/notifications. UI checks: /sign-in shows the Clerk form in Turkish (Google button + e-mail field) and /sign-up renders. Admin sign-in with __clerk_ticket works: header shows the Yönetici link and avatar, and /admin shows stats, critical stock, best sellers, the orders board (38 orders) and products (13). The session survives a refresh. Guest flow: add to cart while signed out, then /odeme shows the guest notice, Adrese/Mağazadan delivery options and 'Online ödeme yakında'; signed-out /siparislerim redirects to /sign-in. After the member signs in with a ticket the guest cart item is merged (count 1, item in /sepet). /siparislerim (empty state) and /favorilerim load, and /admin redirects the member to /. Sign-out through the Clerk UserButton brings back the signed-out header.
